OrgName.description: Organization name used in the generated package metadata and README. Placed via the collision-free 'OrgNamePlaceholder' sentinel so it never touches ResQ.Service or ResQ.BuildingBlocks.* identifiers.

DatabaseProvider.description: The EF Core provider wired into the Infrastructure ring.

choices.description: PostgreSQL via Npgsql with snake_case naming (production default).

IncludeMessaging.description: Include the integration-event + domain-event-handler messaging slice (AddResqMessaging). When false, those folders and the messaging wiring are dropped.

IncludeOutbox.description: Enable the transactional outbox (AddResqPersistence UseOutbox = true), which also registers the OutboxRelay hosted service.

Framework.description: Target framework. Only net9.0 is offered: the generated service references the net9-only Adapters.Web / Testing.Integration packages, so a net8.0 choice would produce a non-restorable combination.

skipRestore.description: If specified, skips the automatic NuGet restore on create.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
